name: design
description: Local Claude-Design clone — canvas-first iteration on HTML mocks under <designRoot> (default `.design/`), element selection via Cmd+Click, auto-managed dev server with React UI and WebSocket active-state tracking. Auto-critic panel after every edit; --perfect mode for N-iteration polish. Continuous README+INDEX maintenance — no zip exports, repo IS the handoff. Per-repo config at .design/config.json. Commands: /design /design:new /design:rollback /design:screenshot /design:critic /design:docs /design:handoff /design:browse.
